app.title: Budget planner
app.license: bbbudget is free software under the {license}
empty.title: No budgets yet
empty.text: Create one from a template to get started.
month.heading: Where {month}'s money goes
insights.heading: What the numbers say
insights.empty: Add income and costs to see insights.
now.heading: This month: {month}
now.empty: Nothing logged this month yet. Tell your AI assistant what you spent, or use “bbbudget log”.
chat.heading: Ask about your budget
chat.placeholder: Ask a question, or tell it what you spent: “I spent 40 on groceries”
chat.privacy_local: Runs on your machine ({model}). Nothing leaves it.
chat.privacy_hosted: Uses {model} at {provider}: your messages and the budget data the assistant reads are sent there. Its changes appear under Recent changes and can be undone.
prefs.assistant.heading: AI assistant
prefs.assistant.text: An assistant in the app that can answer questions and change the budget for you. Off by default. A hosted model receives your messages and the budget data it reads; a local one (Ollama, LM Studio) keeps everything on your machine.
prefs.assistant.key_placeholder: Paste a key to set or replace it
activity.heading: Recent changes
activity.text: Every change, whoever made it: you, an AI assistant or a rate refresh. Undo puts back the version from before it, as a new change you can undo too.
settings.heading: Budget settings
field.name: Name
currencies.heading: Currencies
currencies.text: Rate is units per 1 of the base currency. Pick where it comes from: the ECB's official rate, market data (which also covers crypto), or type it yourself. Payment loss is added to every payment in that currency; cash-out loss is taken off income in it, such as fees for selling crypto.
rate.fetch_failed: Couldn't get the {code} rate ({error}), so nothing changed. To use {code} anyway, set “Rate from” to “Typed by hand” and type its rate.
rates.off: Fetching rates is turned off in Settings.
rates.all_manual: Every rate is typed by hand. Pick a “Rate from” source for the ones to keep current.
items.heading: Income and costs
items.text: Amounts are exact. A one-off happens once, in its start month.
debts.heading: Debts
debts.text: Interest is charged monthly at APR ÷ 12. The minimum is paid each month until the balance is zero.
debts.empty: No debts. Add credit cards or loans to see interest and payoff dates.
goals.heading: Savings goals
categories.heading: Categories
categories.in_use: “{label}” is still used by an item.
field.label: Label
scenarios.heading: Scenarios
scenarios.text: Try changes without touching the real budget, save them, and compare side by side.
scenarios.empty: Add a change to see what it would do.
scenarios.bad_value: Each new value must be a plain number like 800 or 92.5

scenarios.result.one: After {count} month: {after} instead of {before}. This month saves {saved}.
scenarios.result.other: After {count} months: {after} instead of {before}. This month saves {saved}.

scenarios.name: Scenario name

status.conflict: This budget was changed elsewhere (e.g. by Claude). Reloaded the latest version.

prefs.title: Settings
prefs.language.heading: Language
prefs.language.text: For this page, the insights and the command line. Assistants answer in the language you write in.
prefs.language.label: Language
prefs.rates.heading: Exchange rates
prefs.rates.text: These apply to every budget. Each budget's own settings (base currency, months, debt strategy) are on the budget page.
prefs.fetch: Fetch exchange rates from the internet
prefs.fetch_hint: Off means fully offline: nothing contacts a rate provider, and every rate is typed by hand.
prefs.auto_status: Automatic updates run while “bbbudget serve” is running.
prefs.cg.heading: CoinGecko API key
prefs.cg.text: Optional. CoinGecko works without a key but limits how often it answers. A free demo key from coingecko.com raises the limit. The key is stored in your settings file and never shown again.
prefs.cg.placeholder: Paste a key to set or replace it
prefs.files.heading: Where things are stored
